siteContext.name: Kumwe-Site
siteContext.description: Canonical site identifier. It must exactly match the site bound into the bearer token; host and forwarding headers never select a site.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique retry key. A completed response is replayed for 24 hours; reuse with a different request is rejected.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong ETag returned by the latest content response.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present and true when a stored result was replayed

PreconditionFailed.description: ETag does not match the current version

Unprocessable.description: Validation failed or retry key was reused

confirmed.description: Required when the compatibility plan changes behaviour or data

confirmation.description: The plan checksum again, for high-impact work

content_type.description: Content type UUID or handle; defaults to the core page type

target_url.description: A #fragment for anchor targets, or a root-relative, http(s), or mailto URL for URL targets.
